jobs.location: Bulgaria, Poland, Spain, Malta, South Africa
jobs.description: About us: BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We re now part of Mastercard, and together we re building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice. We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration. Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we re assembling a world-class team to make it happen. Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today. By combining Mastercard s global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK s stablecoin infrastructure, we re building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation. We re a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift. We re incredibly honored to have been recognized by: CNBC World s Top Fintech Companies (2026) FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026) Newsweek s The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025) LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025) Location : We offer a Hybrid/Remote working policy. FUNCTION: Product We re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Fiat product team and own the operational backbone of our fiat payment flows. Every day, BVNK moves money for enterprise customers across SEPA, SWIFT, ACH, RTGS

jobs.title: Cloud Operations Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role Join a cloud operations team supporting the delivery and reliable operation of cloud-based systems for customers. You will help improve scalability, resilience, and day-to-day service quality across cloud environments. What You'll Do Build automation to deploy and scale cloud-based applications efficiently. Monitor systems, investigate incidents, and conduct root-cause analysis to improve reliability. Optimize CI/CD pipelines and automate infrastructure using Terraform and Kubernetes. Develop scaling strategies, plan capacity, and implement fault-tolerance measures. Provide second-level technical support, help customers optimize cloud environments, and contribute to operational and on-call incident response. What We're Looking For At least 3 years of experience in cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, building and maintaining cloud-based systems. Hands-on experience building scalable, fault-tolerant architectures with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS. Extensive experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure automation and deployments. Experience implementing proactive monitoring with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Azure Monitor. Strong incident analysis and troubleshooting skills, including automating remediation and improving production systems. Experience in second-level support or a similar technical support role, as well as production on-call operations. Experience with capacity planning and resilience measures; strong communication skills and agile team experience. German proficiency at C2 level and English proficiency at C1 level. Compensation & Benefits Visa sponsorship is not available. Location Hybrid role based in Berlin, Germany. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Our B2B solutions, Codapay , Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud , enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together. If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you. You’ll architect, build, secure and maintain the cloud infrastructure behind Coda’s platforms. Beyond daily operations, you’ll help us manage infrastructure better at scale, strengthen our AWS security and make changes safer and simpler for engineering teams. You’ll work closely with engineers across the company to solve infrastructure challenges, improve reliability and cut down manual work through automation. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
jobs.description: The role HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group s cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognised as the go-to expert on cost across the team.   You will... Develop a harmonised cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets. Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions. Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalisation and consolidation opportunities. Report progress against the group s ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.   You are.... An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership. Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging. A cle

jobs.title: CDI - ARCHITECT PROJECT MANAGER (F/H)
jobs.description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). ROLE This temporary position is to be filled as soon as possible. Support the Architecture/Store Planning team in the development, management, monitoring and coordination of architectural projects for the opening/renovation of our boutiques respecting the brief, budget and management of schedules. MISSIONS Design : Prepare and collect the information necessary for the implementation of projects, debrief and coordination through various departments Prepare CAD drawings, 3D models and project presentations for design development Material research and sample-boards preparation Planning control/coordinati

jobs.description: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position description Sonar is becoming an AI-first company. Strategy Enablement turns Sonar's strategic ideas into real, lasting results: company-critical initiatives, business transformations, acquisition integrations and new market expansion. As Sr. Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives, you will lead some of these initiatives from fuzzy intent to measurable outcome with pace and focus, as a trusted thought partner to leadership. Everything we do ultimately serves our internal and external customers, and you will keep them at the center of the solutions you design. You will reinvent both how projects are run and what they deliver: you use AI agents every day in your own work, and you design solutions AI-first, ambitious yet practical. Your first focus will be the AI transformation of our Go-To-Market organization, with our Business Technology team (including SALT, its AI team) and the Data & Insights team. jobs.description: Job Responsibilities Deploy, configure, update, and maintain software applications and services on Linux-based robotic devices. Troubleshoot software and system issues, including service failures, resource usage problems, and network connectivity issues. Develop Shell or Python scripts to automate software deployment and routine maintenance tasks. Support OTA software updates, remote device maintenance, and troubleshooting of upgrade failures. Basic understanding of TCP/IP, SSH, and Linux networking. Good problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively with R&D teams. Chinese and English are the working languages; good working proficiency in both is required. Preferred Qualifications Experience with robotic systems, embedded Linux, or other smart devices. Familiarity with OTA updates, remote device management, or software version control. Basic knowledge of DDS, ROS2, Docker, or CI/CD tools. What we offer A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors. Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment. Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow. Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth. Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month. Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environ
